customSections.label: Which LCPS Calendar Is Shown Here?
customSections.content: This page follows the LCPS 2027–28 student calendar. Staff members and families using a program-specific schedule should confirm the calendar assigned to them.

customSections.label: Major Breaks and Return Dates
customSections.content: These ranges and return dates follow the LCPS student calendar.

groups.label: Thanksgiving Break
items: Thanksgiving Break runs November 24–26, 2027. Students return Monday, November 29.

groups.label: Winter Break
items: Winter Break runs December 20–31, 2027. Students return Monday, January 3, 2028.

groups.label: Spring Break
items: Spring Break runs Monday, April 10 through Friday, April 14, 2028. Students return Monday, April 17.

groups.label: Holiday dates
items: The LCPS student calendar marks October 11, October 29, January 26, and February 25 as holidays when schools are closed. This page uses a specific observance name only when an official source supports that label.

groups.label: Weather and emergency changes
items: LCPS posts closures, delayed openings, and early dismissals on its website and sends divisionwide notifications. The downloadable calendar on this page is a one-time import and does not update automatically.

whatsNew.title: What Changed From 2026–27
content: The first day moves from August 17 in 2026–27 to August 19 in 2027–28, two calendar days later.
Spring Break moves from March 22–26 in 2026–27 to April 10–14 in 2027–28.
The last day moves from June 11 in 2026–27 to June 14 in 2027–28, three calendar days later.
